title: trim whitespace from input handler
description: src/handler.js exports a function `handle(input)` that should reject empty input and trim leading/trailing whitespace. Currently it does neither — the tests in test.js demonstrate both failures.

issue.title: handle() does not trim whitespace or reject empty input
issue.body:
Two acceptance tests are failing in test.js:

1. `handle('')` should throw an Error with message containing 'empty' — it currently returns ''.
2. `handle('  hello  ')` should return 'hello' — it currently returns '  hello  '.

Update src/handler.js to satisfy both.
